desc:
The soft hum of hidden strings and faint light blooming in the deep night, where sharpness and calm intertwine, transforming into a silent melody. Thread by thread, it captures everything held dear within.

<color=#959595>"This? It's just a device for storing instrument strings."
—Evelyn, gently strumming the strings. A low hum fills the air, and as the final note echoes, the enemy falls silent.</color>
desc2: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: The sound of the strings, sharp as blades, cut through the night, protecting the one.
name: Heartstring Nocturne

1.desc: CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>. When the equipper enters combat, or activates a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, they gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Heartstring</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Heartstring</color> allows the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to ignore <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color> of the target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
1.name: String & Melody
